(1) 세포와 혈액생성에 필요
(2) 태아 신경관의 정상 발달에 필요
(3) 혈액의 호모시스테인 수준을 정상으로 유지하는데 필요

비타민 C
(1) 결합조직 형성과 기능유지에 필요

비타민 D :
(1) 칼슘과 인이 흡수되고 이용되는데 필요
(2) 뼈의 형성과 유지에 필요
(3) 골다공증발생 위험 감소에 도움을 줌

마그네슘 :
(1) 에너지 이용에 필요
(2) 신경과 근육 기능 유지에 필요

비타민 B12
(1) 정상적인 엽산 대사에 필요

멀티비타민 부스터Niacin · Magnesium · Biotin · Vitamin B1 · Vitamin B12 · Vitamin B2 · Vitamin B6 · Vitamin C · Vitamin D · Folate · Pantothenic acid

Made by (주)오투바이오 · Once a day · 1 sachet

This product combines 15mg of Niacin, 94.5mg of Magnesium, 30μg of Biotin, 1.2mg of Vitamin B1, 2.4μg of Vitamin B12, 1.4mg of Vitamin B2, 1.5mg of Vitamin B6, 30mg of Vitamin C, 10μg of Vitamin D, 480μg of Folate, 5mg of Pantothenic acid as labelled amounts. The officially recognised functions of each are listed below.

Why this product

  • Once a day (1 sachet): 15mg Niacin, 94.5mg Magnesium, 30μg Biotin, 1.2mg Vitamin B1, 2.4μg Vitamin B12, 1.4mg Vitamin B2, 1.5mg Vitamin B6, 30mg Vitamin C, 10μg Vitamin D, 480μg Folate, 5mg Pantothenic acid
  • Coliform negative — meets its MFDS notified standard
  • Made by (주)오투바이오

Officially recognised functions by ingredient

  • Niacin
    • Needed for energy production in the body
  • Magnesium
    • Needed for energy utilisation
    • Needed to help maintain normal nerve and muscle function
  • Biotin
    • Needed for the metabolism of fat, carbohydrate and protein and for energy production
  • Vitamin B1
    • Needed for carbohydrate and energy metabolism
  • Vitamin B12
    • Needed for normal folate metabolism
  • Vitamin B2
    • Needed for energy production in the body
  • Vitamin B6
    • Needed for protein and amino acid utilisation
    • Needed to help maintain normal blood homocysteine levels
  • Vitamin C
    • Needed for the formation and maintenance of connective tissue
    • Needed for the absorption of iron
    • Needed to protect cells from harmful oxygen (free radicals)
  • Vitamin D
    • Needed for the absorption and utilisation of calcium and phosphorus
    • Needed for the formation and maintenance of bone
    • Recognised as helping reduce the risk of developing osteoporosis
  • Folate
    • Needed to help maintain normal blood homocysteine levels
    • Needed for cell and blood formation
    • Needed for the normal development of the fetal neural tube
  • Pantothenic acid
    • Needed for the metabolism of fat, carbohydrate and protein and for energy production

Directions (exactly as officially stated)

Once a day1 sachet per serving

Magnesium labelled (94.5mg / 2500mg), 80~150%
Biotin labelled (30μg / 2500mg), 80~180%

Vitamin B2 labelled (1.4mg / 2500mg), 80~180%

Coliform Negative

Storage 직사광선을 피하여 서늘한 곳에 실온보관하십시오.

Who it suits

  • Those who want to take Niacin · Magnesium · Biotin · Vitamin B1 · Vitamin B12 · Vitamin B2 · Vitamin B6 · Vitamin C · Vitamin D · Folate · Pantothenic acid together daily
  • Those who prefer this form
  • Those who want a convenient way to manage multiple nutrients
Precautions · Consult a professional if you have hypercalcaemia or take medication · Stop use and consult a professional if adverse effects occur · Refer to the official cautions printed on the product
